concurrent_load: Other acceptance processes may run; not an exclusive host
measurement_clock: All fact/trend stages first wait for a new completed data-hz-render with workspace=review; conservative upper bounds exclude stale prior DOM. Click samples start at captured DOM click; first open starts before page.goto. Full report generation is never invoked.
cold_design: Three separate processes/backups: direct preview in a new process; running app initialized on settings then first selected week/month preview. Only selected period is requested. Analysis clock equals original acceptance cutoff; source dates and conditions unchanged. Hot return has 30 independent real navigation clicks, new render identities and checked facts/plot arrays.
